title: Yam Bowling
tagline: Pick your bowler. Find the pocket. Feed the competition.
description: A character-driven arcade bowling cabinet with a 30-bowler canon roster, three-frame Quick Bowl or regulation ten-frame Classic Ten scoring, playable locally, against CPU opponents, or online through Quick Match and private rooms. Signed-in players can also run a five-division circuit campaign and rotating CPU tournament brackets, with cosmetic progression (skins, rooms, effects) unlocked through XP and vouchers.
status: Playable - local, vs CPU, online multiplayer, circuit campaign, and tournaments
